scope: Workspace durable pin/default fields and queued pin/archive lifecycle

verification.native: 127 tests passed across new pin/archive queue faults, previous Workspace registries, storage and Remote consumers.
verification.source: 19 original archive/unarchive/pin/unpin and archive follow-up tests passed in the focused run. Earlier whole Workspace file had 81 passed and 3 EPERM symlink-creation failures; original diagnostics retained, not labelled a complete pass.

behavior: Explicit current version-2 spec adds defaultWorkspaceId/pinnedSessionIds, defaults old omitted arrays, validates string elements and pending markers and strips unknown fields. Historical spec stays unchanged.

Current candidate registry serializes accepted pin/archive/unarchive/unpin alongside create/delete/reorder, shields accepted operations from abandoned callers and permits subsequent work after rejection.

Pin order is newest first, duplicate pins do not reorder, archiving drops a pin in the same commit. Activity refusal writes nothing; stopActivity commits before fan-out stops and follow-up admission. Stop/follow-up failure retains the archive; failed unarchive admission preserves it.
Actual JSON cold reopen retains archive/pin state. Persistence failures propagate instead of masquerading as unknown Session errors.

limitations: Finite registry pin/archive scope. Default Workspace initialization, complete create/delete journal faults, missing-directory membership and current Workspace Remote feed/authorization remain follow-up work; no application binding added yet.
